name: joxo
description: Joxo for Claude Code: the setup skill, the live channel for teammates' messages and handoffs, and a quiet live view of your team (a mod: band, pane, toasts) that only reads through the joxo command you already installed.

nodePath.title: Node.js path
nodePath.description: Absolute path of the node that runs joxo. `joxo setup` fills this in; leave it empty and run joxo setup.

joxoPath.title: joxo path
joxoPath.description: Absolute path of joxo.mjs (usually ~/.joxo/bin/joxo.mjs). `joxo setup` fills this in; leave it empty and run joxo setup. The mod never looks joxo up by name.
